command: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); printf '%s\n' '--- relaunch ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity; sleep 1; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true; PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; printf 'PID=%s\n' "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d --pid="$PID" -v brief '*:E' | tail -80 || true
